description: Probabilistic forecast guidance for one aspect, from severe risk to aviation ceilings: percentiles (p10 to p90), exceedance probabilities and ensemble spread, for the odds, ranges or confidence one forecast value cannot answer. Read p50 as the likely outcome, p90 as the reasonable worst case when the risk is the high end (snow, wind, rain) and p10 when it is the low end (cold, visibility, ceiling). Aspects: precip, snow, ice, temperature (daily high and low ranges), wind, severe (thunderstorm and severe-environment odds; SPC tornado, hail and wind odds are get_outlooks (guidance)), aviation (ceiling and visibility odds) and confidence (spread). Example: {"location": "Denver, CO", "aspect": "snow", "hours": 72}.

aspect.description: Which aspect to read: one of precip, aviation, confidence, ice, severe, snow, temperature, wind.

card.description: Shape the card (guide://smarterweather/views): intent only; the server fills the rest from the data.

actions.description: Up to two follow-ups the user can tap, each sending its prompt as a new turn; never one the card answers itself.

focus.description: ISO 8601 time inside the result's window to preselect.

op.description: At or above, or at or below.

title.description: An answer, not a label; up to 48 characters.

hours.description: Time: a rolling window of this many hours (ahead for a forecast, back for an analysis) (>= 1).

location.description: Space: one place (place text, ZIP or `lat,lon`). EDR position; `nearest` on a feature product (non-empty).

units.description: imperial (default), metric or si (each variable's catalog `units`).
